name: Suncorp Group
h1: Digital Insurer delivery, on one connected layer
lede: Suncorp is rolling its Duck Creek based Digital Insurer platform into AAMI and scaling AI across the business. Airtable helps the teams running those programs work from one shared view.
why_p: A core platform rollout into the flagship brand, a new customer, brand and digital function, and a strong bottom-up build culture make this a natural moment to connect how programs run.

signals.title: FY26 results fund continued Digital Insurer investment
signals.body: Suncorp reported net profit after tax of $1.027bn. Operating expenses rose 3.4%, mainly from investment in the Digital Insurer program and AI.
signals.angle: Give program leaders one view of transformation workstreams, dependencies and spend.

signals.title: New Customer, Brand and Digital function
signals.body: Executive changes announced with the FY26 results created a unified customer, brand and digital role led by Bridget Messer.
signals.angle: A new function benefits from a shared operating system for campaigns, launches and digital work from day one.

signals.title: Duck Creek recognises Digital Insurer delivery
signals.body: Suncorp won a Duck Creek Standard of Excellence Customer Award for its Digital Insurer program, now well into delivery for AAMI.
signals.angle: Coordinate release planning and business readiness for each brand migration in one place.

signals.title: Digital Insurer live in New Zealand
signals.body: The Duck Creek platform went live for AA Insurance in New Zealand, with the next release rolling into AAMI.
signals.angle: Reuse the playbook from the first release across brands with a connected program tracker.
